source: User explicit authorization 2026-10-17: ultimate goal is closed-loop stability; conditional controller/theory changes including time-varying terminal theory are allowed during theory clay stage.
decision: Proceed with a candidate time-varying terminal MPC extension that preserves the single-shot Frozen-LTV QP, then test whether it yields a conditional practical-stability/ultimate-bounded-tracking theorem. This is research-only and not yet a formal controller or paper edit.
rule: Keep time-varying trajectory tracking as the target; no fixed-reference substitution.
Candidate terminal cost may be quadratic in the augmented terminal state and remain QP-compatible under frozen affine prediction.
Prefer polyhedral/linear terminal constraints if hard constraints are needed, because ellipsoidal quadratic constraints would change QP class.
Account for reference consistency, previous-input augmentation, model/freeze error tightening, common feasible sets, time-varying terminal domains and local terminal feedback.
Do not claim stability until the full proof closes.
boundary: No Main.tex/code/experiment/figure edits in this research phase.
Physical-plant stability still requires a plant-model bridge and detection assumptions.
